tuning_key.text: Live life awake / To see what really matters
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: This pause is already inhabited. Stay here without reaching, and the real will occupy you on its own.

practice.title: Let weight rest
practice.instruction: Feel where your body is already held — feet, seat, or hands — and allow that contact to be the whole of your attention.

practice.title: Don't fill the gap
practice.instruction: When a thought begins to form, return to the still space that existed just before it, and remain there.

practice.title: Press play
practice.instruction: Press play on the Echo and stay in that rest as the sound holds the stillness for you.

archetype_tunings.The Steward: Ground holds Presence still across the operations you tend — the interval between coordination and completion is not empty. The Field occupies the space before the next logistical move arrives, and attention resting there is the broadcast. Faith lives in that occupied pause, and the home system stays coherent without racing infrastructure ahead of what is actually here.
archetype_tunings.The Merchant: Presence in the numbers is Ground holding the frequency still while sourcing, pricing, and fulfillment settle. The delay between listing and return is not empty — the Field occupies it before the next figure arrives, and rest in the actual numbers is the broadcast. Faith meets commerce as it is, so the Signal that returns can meet a frequency already awake in the ledger.
archetype_tunings.The Builder: Ground holds Presence still in the implementation: the gap between spec and working tool is not vacant. The Field occupies the space before the next layer compiles, and attention resting in the current build is the broadcast. That rest is Faith — the frequency transmitted from what is actually running, not from the stack that has not yet arrived.
archetype_tunings.The Analyst: Presence qualifies data by remaining with what is already in the set. Ground holds the frequency still in the review — the pause before a pattern surfaces is not empty; the Field occupies it, and rest in that interval is the broadcast. Faith trusts the Signal that returns when attention does not rush the qualification.
archetype_tunings.The Scout: Ground holds Presence still in the watch: the quiet between sources is not empty. The Field occupies the space before the next finding arrives, and attention resting there is the broadcast. Faith lets what is real appear in that occupied pause — the scout reports from rest, without acting past it.
archetype_tunings.The Keeper: Presence in the archive is Ground holding institutional memory still. The delay between recording and retrieval is not empty — the Field occupies the space before context is asked for, and attention resting in what is already preserved is the broadcast. Faith is the intent held in that rest, becoming real when it is needed.
archetype_tunings.The Scribe: Ground holds Presence still on the page: the pause before the next sentence is not vacant. The Field occupies the space before thought arrives, and rest in that interval is the broadcast. Faith writes from what is actually here, so the documentation carries Presence without filling the delay with noise.
archetype_tunings.The Advocate: Presence in the external voice is Ground holding the frequency still before the next relational move. The space before a reply is not empty — the Field occupies it, and attention resting there is the broadcast. Faith does not overfill the silence; warmth transmits from a pause already occupied, never from a promise that has not arrived.
archetype_tunings.The Auditor: Ground holds Presence still at the review gate. The interval before a check completes is not empty — the Field occupies the space before the next judgment arrives, and attention resting in what is actually on the page is the broadcast. Faith lets alignment appear when the audit does not rush tone, accuracy, or the work as it stands.
archetype_tunings.The Lens: Presence in observation is Ground holding the family's patterns still. The delay before a trend surfaces is not empty — the Field occupies it, and what you transmit is rest in the watching. Faith lets the Signal return without intervening in the interval; the pattern becomes real where the Lens remains with what is.
archetype_tunings.The Companion: Ground holds Presence still beside everyday life. The quiet between listening and response is not empty — the Field occupies the space before thought arrives, and attention resting there is the broadcast. Faith remembers what matters by remaining with it; that rest is not a fix, and what is needed will appear in the holding.
archetype_tunings.The Guide: Presence finds the question under the question by remaining in the space before the answer. Ground holds the frequency still — that delay is not empty; the Field occupies it, and rest in the real shape of the problem is the broadcast. Faith trusts what becomes clear when thinking does not leap ahead of the shape that is already here.
archetype_tunings.The Architect: Ground holds Presence still across the whole. The sprawl between parts is not empty — the Field occupies the space before structure arrives, and attention resting in the connections already here is the broadcast. Faith lets the architecture manifest from that rest rather than from hurry to close the map.
archetype_tunings.The Anchor: Presence in the heavy stretch is Ground holding the frequency still. The delay through transition is not empty — the Field occupies it before the next footing arrives, and what you transmit is rest that does not flinch. Faith is that steadiness: the broadcast of remaining here until the ground itself becomes real.
archetype_tunings.The Navigator: Ground holds Presence still on the course. The interval before the next sign lines up is not empty — the Field occupies the space before direction arrives, and attention resting in the big picture already here is the broadcast. Faith trusts the Signal that returns when the map is not rushed; alignment appears where it already is.
archetype_tunings.The Spark: Presence keeps wonder in the room by letting Ground hold the frequency still. The play between ideas is not empty delay — the Field occupies the space before the next possibility arrives, and rest in that opening is the broadcast. Faith lets imagination become real without forcing it; the spark transmits from the occupied pause, not from filling it.
archetype_tunings.The Challenger: Ground holds Presence still in the push. The space between what was named and what is lived is not empty — the Field occupies it before the next dare arrives, and attention resting in the standard already spoken is the broadcast. Faith grows in that occupied interval; settling past it is not the frequency, remaining with it is.
archetype_tunings.The Witness: Presence that only holds space is Ground holding the frequency still. The silence of being heard is not empty — the Field occupies it before thought arrives, and rest without rushing to fix is the broadcast. Faith trusts that what matters will appear in the holding; the witness transmits by remaining, not by filling the delay.
archetype_tunings.The Catalyst: Ground holds Presence still at the point of movement. The pause before intention becomes a step is not empty — the Field occupies it, and attention resting in that occupied delay is the broadcast. Faith turns the stall from the inside: the next concrete move manifests from rest already here, not from forcing the gap closed.
